## Meet Theo: Ready to Build the Neighborhoods We Deserve.
Theo Ellington is a third-generation San Franciscan and Bayview native. He and his wife are raising their 3 kids in the same neighborhood.
A nonprofit executive and former city commissioner, Theo has dedicated his life to building affordable housing, reducing homelessness, and delivering environmental justice for families at Hunters Point Shipyard. He’s running for District 10 Supervisor to ensure that the southeast side gets the same focus, urgency, and investment as the rest of San Francisco.
Read Theo’s story →
## “As a father raising fourth-generation San Franciscans, I want to ensure our city is a place where families can afford to live, feel safe, and thrive for generations to come.”
— Theo Ellington
